title: Two-Step Equations
seo_title: Grade 7 Two-Step Equations Worksheets: px + q = r, p(x + q) = r and Word Problems
standard_text: Solve word problems leading to equations of the form px + q = r and p(x + q) = r, where p, q, and r are specific rational numbers. Solve equations of these forms fluently. Compare an algebraic solution to an arithmetic solution, identifying the sequence of the operations used in each approach.
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 two-step equations worksheets: undo the steps in reverse order, solve px + q = r and p(x + q) = r with negatives, decimals and fractions, check solutions, and write equations for word problems. 100 practice questions with an answer key.
key_big: Undo the steps in reverse order: first the adding or subtracting, then the multiplying or dividing.
key_sub: 3x + 5 = 20 → 3x = 15 → x = 5. Do the same thing to both sides, then check your answer.
body_html:
Undo in reverse order

In 3x + 5, you multiply by 3 first, then add 5. To solve, undo these steps backwards: first undo the + 5, then undo the × 3. Do the same thing to both sides so the equation stays balanced.

EquationStep 1ResultStep 2Answer
3x + 5 = 20subtract 53x = 15divide by 3x = 5
4x − 7 = 13add 74x = 20divide by 4x = 5
−2x + 9 = 1subtract 9−2x = −8divide by −2x = 4
2(x + 3) = 16divide by 2x + 3 = 8subtract 3x = 5
Example

Solve 6x − 4 = 26.

Add 4 to both sides: 6x = 30.

Divide both sides by 6: x = 5.

Check: 6 × 5 − 4 = 30 − 4 = 26.

Answer: x = 5

Example

A taxi charges $3 plus $2 per mile. A ride costs $27. How many miles?

Write an equation: 2m + 3 = 27.

Subtract 3: 2m = 24.

Divide by 2: m = 12.

Answer: 12 miles

Common mistakes

  • Adding instead of subtracting: in 3x + 5 = 20, take away 5 (15), do not add it (25).
  • Dividing first: 3x + 5 = 20 is not x + 5 = 20 ÷ 3. Undo the + 5 first.
  • Distributing to only one term: 2(x + 3) is 2x + 6, not 2x + 3.
  • Losing a sign: −2x = −8 gives x = 4, not −4.

faq.q: How do you solve a two-step equation?
faq.a: Undo the operations in reverse order. For 3x + 5 = 20, subtract 5 from both sides to get 3x = 15, then divide both sides by 3 to get x = 5.

faq.q: How do I solve p(x + q) = r?
faq.a: Divide both sides by p, then undo q. For 2(x + 3) = 16, divide by 2 to get x + 3 = 8, so x = 5. You can also distribute first: 2x + 6 = 16.

faq.q: How do I check my answer?
faq.a: Put your answer back into the original equation. If both sides are equal, it is correct: 3 × 5 + 5 = 20.

faq.q: How do I write an equation from a word problem?
faq.a: Find the unknown and give it a letter. A fixed amount is the constant, and an amount for each item is the coefficient: $3 plus $2 per mile is 2m + 3.

sets.title: Two steps: undo in reverse order

items.q: What is a good first step to solve 3x + 5 = 20?
items.e: Undo the adding or subtracting first, then undo the multiplying. In 3x + 5 = 20 the constant is 5, so subtract 5 from both sides first.

items.q: What is a good first step to solve 4x − 7 = 13?
items.e: Undo the adding or subtracting first, then undo the multiplying. In 4x − 7 = 13 the constant is −7, so add 7 to both sides first.

items.q: What is a good first step to solve −2x + 9 = 1?
items.e: Undo the adding or subtracting first, then undo the multiplying. In −2x + 9 = 1 the constant is 9, so subtract 9 from both sides first.

items.q: What is a good first step to solve 5x + 12 = −3?
items.e: Undo the adding or subtracting first, then undo the multiplying. In 5x + 12 = −3 the constant is 12, so subtract 12 from both sides first.

items.q: After the first step of solving 6x + 4 = 22, which equation do you get?
items.e: Undo + 4 on both sides: 6x = 22 − 4 = 18.

items.q: After the first step of solving 7x − 5 = 9, which equation do you get?
items.e: Undo − 5 on both sides: 7x = 9 + 5 = 14.

items.q: After the first step of solving −3x + 8 = −4, which equation do you get?
items.e: Undo + 8 on both sides: −3x = −4 − 8 = −12.
Put 5 in for x: 2 × 5 + 7 = 17 = 17. So it is a solution.

Put −4 in for x: −2 × (−4) − 5 = 3 = 3. So it is a solution.

items.q: Solve 34x + 12 = 2.
items.e: Subtract 12 from both sides: 34x = 1 12. Then divide both sides by 34: x = 2. Check: 34 × 2 + 12 = 2. Not 3 13: that adds 12 instead of undoing it.
Subtract 5 from both sides: −13x = −2. Then divide both sides by −13: x = 6. Check: −13 × 6 + 5 = 3. Not −24: that adds 5 instead of undoing it.
Subtract 14 from both sides: 3x = 3 34. Then divide both sides by 3: x = 1 14. Check: 3 × 1 14 + 14 = 4. Not 1 512: that adds 14 instead of undoing it.
Add 1 to both sides: 25x = 4. Then divide both sides by 25: x = 10. Check: 25 × 10 − 1 = 3. Not 5: that subtracts 1 instead of undoing it.

items.q: Mia pays a $15 sign-up fee and $8 for each class. She spends $87 in all. How many classes did she take?
items.e: 8c + 15 = 87, so 8c = 72 and c = 9 classes.

items.q: A taxi charges $3 plus $2 per mile. Luis's ride costs $27. How many miles was the ride?
items.e: 2m + 3 = 27, so 2m = 24 and m = 12 miles.

items.q: A phone plan costs $25 a month plus $0.10 for each text. One month's bill is $31.50. How many texts were sent?
The perimeter of a rectangle is 46 cm. Its length is 15 cm. What is its width?
A rectangle has width 7 in. and perimeter 50 in. What is its length?
Hana has $120 and saves $15 each week. After how many weeks will she have $255?
Three friends share the cost of a pizza equally. Each also pays $2 for a drink. Each friend pays $7 in all. How much did the pizza cost?
items.e: p/3 + 2 = 7, so p/3 = 5 and p = 15 dollars.

items.q: The temperature is −4°F and rises 3°F each hour. After how many hours will it be 14°F?
items.e: 3h + (−4) = 14, so 3h = 18 and h = 6 hours.

items.q: A diver at −10 feet goes down 6 feet each minute. After how many minutes is she at −58 feet?
items.e: −6m − 10 = −58, so −6m = −48 and m = 8 minutes.

items.q: A gym charges $40 to join and $25 a month. Ana has paid $240 in all. How many months has she been a member?
items.e: 25m + 40 = 240, so 25m = 200 and m = 8 months.

items.q: A tank has 500 gallons of water. It drains 35 gallons each hour. After how many hours will 185 gallons be left?
Chloe bought 4 notebooks and a $6 pen. She spent $26. How much was each notebook?
items.e: 4n + 6 = 26, so 4n = 20 and n = 5 dollars.

items.q: Twice a number, plus 9, is 35. What is the number?
A number divided by 4, minus 3, is 5. What is the number?
Five less than 3 times a number is 31. What is the number?
A concert hall has 30 rows with the same number of seats, plus 24 box seats. It has 924 seats in all. How many seats are in each row?
Each of 6 students gets the same number of stickers. The teacher keeps 14. There were 98 stickers. How many did each student get?
items.e: 6s + 14 = 98, so 6s = 84 and s = 14 stickers.

items.q: A plumber charges $65 for the visit plus $48 per hour. The bill is $257. How many hours did the plumber work?
items.e: 48h + 65 = 257, so 48h = 192 and h = 4 hours.

items.q: A school buys 3 boxes of markers at the same price and gets $5 off. It pays $37. What is the price of one box?
items.e: 3b − 5 = 37, so 3b = 42 and b = 14 dollars.

items.q: The sum of two numbers is 45. One number is 3 more than twice the other. What is the smaller number?
items.e: n + (2n + 3) = 45, so 3n + 3 = 45, 3n = 42 and n = 14. The other number is 31.
